I3.location: p. 8, Table 1 caption (column heads: High pressure manual system (11 MPa); PCI system (3.59 MPa))

notes: I1: Table 1 gives measured capacities for graphite flakes, activated carbon, nanotubes, PYROGRAF and VGCF samples (for example activated carbon 0.041+/-0.014 wt.% on the PCI system); the high pressure manual system gives upper limits only. I3: Table 1 states 23 C (text layer reads '238C'; page image shows 23 C) with 3.59 MPa (PCI) and 11 MPa (manual). I4 not met: the only surface-area value is the 700 m2/g for Norit Darco G-60, introduced with 'generally has ... around', which is a statement typical of wood-based carbon and not a value for the sample measured or a supplier's value for the product used (protocol 15, Amendment 1). The same sentence says the carbon has an area 'approximately 70 times larger than the VGCF [10]', a ratio citing the authors' earlier work with no value for any sample. No other surface area, BET, N2 isotherm or porosity value for any measured sample appears in the text layer (searched for surface, BET, m2/g, nitrogen) or on pages 2 and 8 viewed as images. I1 to I3 and I5 are met, no earlier exclusion code applies (experimental gas-phase work, not electrochemical, carbon sorbents measured, original article, no retraction notice in the text), so the first applicable code is no_surface_area.
